title: Summary Starts Empty
description: The Booking Summary sidebar is supposed to fill in as you go — which means it has to have a clean, honest empty state before you've entered anything at all.
successCondition: On first loading /book with a fresh wizard, the Booking Summary sidebar's Origin, Destination, and Package fields all display the placeholder text "—" (em dash), not blank strings, not "undefined", and not "0".
hints: The sidebar is the third column on desktop widths — resize or scroll if it's not immediately visible.
This is checking the literal rendered text, so distinguish an em dash "—" from a similar-looking hyphen "-".
